summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K (equivalent of a US 8-K) reporting ongoing B-share repurchases under a pre-announced DKK 15 billion programme running from 4 February 2026 for 12 months. The latest tranche, announced 6 May 2026, authorizes up to DKK 11.2 billion in repurchases through 1 February 2027. As of 4 June 2026, 18.8 million B shares were repurchased at an average price of DKK 264.32 (~$38), with 4,000,000 shares bought in the current tranche. The company holds 0.8% of share capital as treasury shares. No advisor or board-specific recommendation is noted; the programme follows EU Safe Harbour Rules. Watch future trading updates and potential impact on EPS.
